name: 70578 · Rayne, LA
findings: ZIP 70578 (Rayne) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70578 (Rayne) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
